### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are recorded for the change addressing streamed text loss when reasoning fields are empty. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes text loss in the shared OpenAI-compatible streaming path when a chunk includes an empty reasoning field. **Changes:** - Allows empty `reasoning` or `reasoning_content` fields to fall through to text handling. - Adds regression tests for both field names and empty reasoning-only chunks. - Documents the fix and its impact on providers using `OpenAICompletionsProvider`. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​test_provider_openai_completions.py` | Adds regression coverage using real chunk objects without network calls. | | `chatlas/​_provider_openai_completions.py` | Returns reasoning content only when it is nonempty, preserving chunk text otherwise. | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Records the streaming fix for OpenAI-compatible providers. |
Review effort: Balanced
